waste.mappingNote: List every type of waste your business produces.
waste.notesPlaceholder: Notes / remarks about this waste stream
waste.mappingInsight: Important note: Businesses tracking waste costs for the first time usually discover they are spending 20–40% more than expected. This number becomes your baseline — every improvement you make brings it down.
waste.assessmentNote: Score honestly: In place · Partial · Not in place · N/A (not applicable).
waste.contractorNote: Score each criterion from 1 to 5. The weighted score is calculated automatically.
waste.checklistTitle: Low score — Checklist for choosing a replacement contractor
waste.checklistNote: Do not sign with a new contractor before every Required item has been verified.
waste.dashboardNote: Record the actual volume and cost every month.
waste.dashboardInsight: Goal: cost/kg should fall as sorting improves and waste volume drops. Cutting total volume by 10% within 90 days is a realistic target for most businesses.
waste.planNote: Focus on 8–10 items at most. Doing 8 things well beats doing 20 things poorly.
waste.milestoneNotePlaceholder: Notes from the review session with the Eco Solutions expert

energy.mapNote: Part A: enter 12 months of electricity & water consumption. Part B: allocate electricity cost by system to find the most power-hungry "hot spots".
energy.partBTitle: Part B — Electricity cost allocation by system
energy.partBNote: Estimate each system's share of the electricity cost. The total should reach 100%. Estimated cost/month is derived from the average electricity cost.
energy.allocWarning: Allocation currently totals {{pct}}% — adjusting it to 100% makes each system's cost estimate more accurate.
energy.assessmentNote: Score honestly: In place · Partial · Not in place · N/A (not applicable). 40 questions · 6 groups.
energy.equipmentNote: kWh/month & cost are auto-calculated: kWh = qty × power × hours/day × days/month ÷ 1000.
energy.equipmentInsight: Tip: compare the inventory total ({{inventory}} kWh/month) with the average actual consumption in the Energy Map ({{actual}} kWh/month) — a large gap means hidden loads or losses to track down.
energy.savingsNote: Enter the investment cost & estimated savings/year for each measure. Payback (years) = investment ÷ savings/year — the smaller the number, the higher the priority.
energy.savingsInsight: Prioritize low-investment, fast-payback measures (LED, fixing leaks, optimizing operations) before considering large investments (solar, BESS).
energy.trackingNote: Intensity (kWh/{{output}}) is the true efficiency metric — normalized by output. The % change shows whether efficiency improves or worsens month by month.
energy.planNote: 9 suggested starter actions. A VIoT expert reviews them with you at the 30/60/90-day milestones.
energy.milestoneNotePlaceholder: Notes from the review session with the VIoT expert

datagov.datamapNote: Record EVERY type of personal data your business collects. This is the foundation of every compliance obligation — you cannot protect data you don't know you hold.
datagov.assessmentNote: 40 questions · 6 groups. Score honestly: In place · Partial · Not in place · N/A. Mapped to PDPL 2025 & Decree 356/2025.
datagov.incidentNote: An 8-step process. NOTIFY WITHIN 72 HOURS of DISCOVERING an incident (if it may cause harm) — per the 2025 PDPL.
datagov.incidentLogNote: Record every incident to support inspections & prove compliance.
datagov.incidentDescPlaceholder: What happened, affected systems/data, how it was handled…
datagov.legalNote: A rolling calendar of compliance obligations: review dates, renewals, owners. Set reminders so nothing is missed.
datagov.planNote: 9 suggested starter actions. A Data Protectify expert reviews them with you at the 30/60/90-day milestones.
datagov.milestoneNotePlaceholder: Notes from the review session with the Data Protectify expert
datagov.resultsNote: Compiled automatically from the Assessment page — score & risk level per group. Red = act now.

legal.title: Rules on invoice issuance timing
legal.item1: Invoice issuance time: under Article 9 of Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, for services this is when the service is completed or when payment is collected (if collected before or during provision), regardless of whether payment has been received.
legal.item2: Requesting an invoice: please submit your request within 7 days of successful payment. Later requests are still supported by DOC but may require an invoice adjustment procedure.
legal.item3: Valid e-invoice: issued under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC, bearing the tax authority's verification code; PDF and XML files are sent to the registered email.
legal.item4: Invoice adjustment / cancellation: if there is an error, contact DOC within 30 days of issuance to have an adjusted or replacement invoice issued as regulated.
